entries.summary: The statistics ministry plans to expand the monthly Index of Services Production to cover education, healthcare, public administration and defence, raising its coverage to 78.4% of services GVA from about 60%. The proposed framework could use UPI transaction data to track private education and healthcare activity and government expenditure data for public services.
entries.title: India to widen services production index to include education, health and defence

entries.summary: The Indian government has approved a ₹10,000-crore SME Growth Fund aimed at supporting small and medium enterprises. Additionally, an Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority has been established to enhance transport infrastructure planning. This fund is intended to address equity capital gaps currently faced by SMEs and facilitate their growth. ITLA will create a comprehensive National Transport Master Plan to improve coordination across various transport sectors.
entries.title: Cabinet approves Rs 10,000-crore SME Growth Fund and new authority to plan transport and logistics

entries.summary: Tata Power Renewable Energy on Monday said the company added 419 megawatt of utility-scale energy generation capacity during July-September 2026, more than double the 182 MW commissioned in the year-ago period. A utility-scale project refers to the installation of a large energy infrastructure designed to generate electricity. Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL) also executed 131.2 MWhr (megawatt hour) of storage projects during the second quarter of FY27, the company said in a statement. During the first half of FY27, the company commissioned several key projects, including the 100.8-MW Jewali Wind Project, the Kalasar FDRE Project comprising 227.5 MW of solar capacity and a 101.2-MWhr Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), the 100 MW Kayathar Group Captive Project, and the 72.5-MW Tata Steel Captive Project. With these additions, the company's utility-scale operational portfolio has grown to 7.2 GW, comprising 5.8 GW of solar, 1.3 GW of wind, and 281.2 MWhr of Battery Stor
entries.title: Tata Power Renewable doubles capacity addition to 419 MW in Q2 FY27

entries.title: Stellantis, Tata Motors PV join hands for vehicle tech, product development

entries.summary: HCLTech will set up a dedicated business unit and centre to develop AI solutions using Anthropic's Claude models and support their enterprise adoption

entries.summary: India's wholesale inflation reached 11.4% in September, significantly increasing from 9.9% in August. Rising prices of fuel, food, and manufactured goods contributed to this surge. Food inflation climbed to 8.7%, marking a 23-month high. Retail inflation also saw an increase, rising to 5.54% year-on-year in September. Economists expect inflation to remain elevated in the coming months due to ongoing global commodity pressures.
entries.title: Wholesale inflation hits series high of 11.4% in September as fuel, food prices surge

entries.title: Hyundai plans ₹4,000 crore investment in Maharashtra, aims to double Pune plant capacity by 2030

entries.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved an outlay of Rs 53,428 crore for the National Social Assistance Programme. This approval will support the program's continuation from 2026-27 to 2030-31 with updated eligibility criteria. Monthly assistance rates for disability pension beneficiaries will increase with adjustments for age and disability severity.
entries.title: Cabinet clears Rs 53,428 crore for social assistance scheme, revises disability pension norms

entries.summary: India's exports increased by 23 per cent to USD 44.4 billion in September, and the trade deficit narrowed to USD 30.21 billion, government data released on Thursday said. The country's imports rose by 8 per cent to USD 74.61 billion in September. India's trade deficit in September 2025 stood at USD 33 billion. During April-September this fiscal, exports jumped 18.51 per cent to USD 259.89 billion, and imports climbed 16.31 per cent to USD 437.53 billion. Exports are maintaining their growth trend, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal said in a press briefing on trade data.
entries.title: India's exports rise 23% to $44.4 bn in September, trade deficit narrows

entries.summary: On Monday, the RBI announced a Rs 1-lakh-crore variable rate repo (VRR) auction for the first time since late July after the weighted average call rate (WACR) at 5.67% on Monday, or 17 basis points higher than the repo rate of 5.50%. The central bank will conduct another VRR for Rs 50,000 crore on Wednesday.
entries.title: RBI injects Rs 1 lakh crore as liquidity tightens before festive season

entries.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is implementing stricter scrutiny on large overseas direct investments by Indian companies. Banks must now collect and present detailed information regarding these investments to the RBI. This initiative aims to prevent potential losses for both the companies and the Indian economy. The RBI's checklist requires banks to conduct thorough due diligence on the rationale behind each investment.
entries.title: RBI tightens scrutiny of $1 billion-plus overseas investments amid rupee pressure

entries.summary: New Zealand is working to strengthen trade relations with Brazil and Canada in response to economic uncertainties. The country expects to complete the first New Zealand-Brazil Trade and Investment Dialogue after upcoming elections. A new free trade agreement with India has been implemented, making more than half of exports tariff-free. The agreement will benefit various products, including sheep meat and wool, as well as local businesses.
entries.title: India-NZ FTA in force: Over half of New Zealand’s exports to India now tariff-free, Wellington also eyes Brazil, Canada

entries.summary: Beijing has announced new export controls on essential machinery, which will impact India's infrastructure development. These restrictions will take effect on November 18 and apply to tunnel boring machines and related items. Additionally, the export controls include walking excavators and specific dredger-related items, complicating several Indian projects.
entries.title: China announces export curbs on key machinery used in India's infrastructure development

entries.summary: Eight of 11 supervisory sectors will be realigned by function from November 1, with dedicated commands for power, coal, steel, oil and gas, and ports.
entries.title: CISF scraps territorial commands, puts sectors under specialist control

entries.summary: Domestic telecom gear maker HFCL has posted a multi-fold jump in consolidated profit to Rs 394.22 crore in the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, driven by demand for optical fibre cables from AI data centres, the company said in a regulatory filing. HFCL had posted net profit of around Rs 72 crore in the same period a year ago. "This is the best-ever quarterly performance in HFCL's history and marks a defining moment in our growth journey. The results reflect the increasing scale, strength and momentum of our business and reinforce our confidence in HFCL's ability to deliver sustained growth and create enduring value for stakeholders," HFCL managing director, Mahendra Nahata, said in a statement. The company has forecasted 80 per cent revenue growth in the current fiscal over financial year (FY) 2026 and expects to achieve the Rs 10,000 crore revenue mark before projected timeline of FY29. HFCL's consolidated revenue from operations more than doubled to Rs 2,541.79 crore dur
entries.title: HFCL Q2 results: Profit surges to ₹394 crore as AI data centre demand rises

entries.summary: Drought conditions have caused a significant decrease in maize supply, leading to competition among industries for access. Poultry producers, starch manufacturers, and ethanol plants are all vying for limited maize resources, exacerbating the situation. As maize prices continue to rise, the poultry industry has expressed concerns about potential feed shortages. Industry bodies have urged the government to prioritize maize for food production over fuel use.
entries.title: India’s drought-hit maize crunch pits poultry, ethanol makers in ‘me first’ fight

This decision aims to mitigate supply constraints following record high sugar prices linked to reduced domestic production and exports.

This repository will offer consolidated information on infrastructure projects for lenders and investors. The platform aims to facilitate access to data sourced from various government agencies like NHAI and others. NaBFID is considering partnerships with financial institutions to enhance the repository's effectiveness.
